item.description:
First release of CC Pilot: switch between your own Claude Code subscription accounts on one Mac, and see each account's remaining usage in the menu bar.
- **Profiles**: each account keeps its own sign-in, so switching never asks you to sign in again. Switching only affects sessions started afterwards, so different terminals can use different accounts at the same time. - **`ccp` command line tool**: `ccp init`, `ccp add`, `ccp use`, `ccp rm`, and `CLAUDE_PROFILE=<name> claude` for a one-off session. - **Menu bar app**: shows the current account's plan and remaining 5-hour usage; the panel lists every profile with its remaining 5-hour and weekly usage, fetched only when you click refresh. - Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 13 or later. English and Simplified Chinese.
---
CC Pilot 首个版本：在一台 Mac 上切换你自己的多个 Claude Code 订阅账号，并在菜单栏查看每个账号的剩余额度。
- **账号**：每个账号各自保持登录，切换时不用重新登录。切换只影响之后新开的会话，不同终端可以同时用不同账号。 - **`ccp` 命令行工具**：`ccp init`、`ccp add`、`ccp use`、`ccp rm`；临时用另一个账号开一次会话：`CLAUDE_PROFILE=<名字> claude`。 - **菜单栏 App**：显示当前账号的套餐和 5 小时窗口剩余额度；面板列出所有账号的 5 小时与每周剩余额度，只在你点刷新时获取。 - 支持 Apple 芯片和 Intel 芯片的 Mac，macOS 13 及以上。界面支持英文和简体中文。
